FAQ
What is a Factory?
A Factory is a workspace where creators collaborate on clips, complete challenges, and earn rewards.
How do I join a Factory?
You can join a Factory after receiving an invitation or by being added by a Factory administrator.
How do I earn money?
You earn money by completing clips and challenges within a Factory. Rewards depend on the Factory's rules and campaign performance.
How can I withdraw my earnings?
Go to the Payments section and submit a withdrawal request using one of the available payment methods.
Where can I track my payments?
You can view your balance, transaction history, and withdrawal requests in the Payments section.
How do Challenges work?
Challenges are linked to specific clips within a Factory. Complete the challenge requirements for a clip to earn the associated reward.

FAQ
What is a Factory?
A Factory is a workspace where creators collaborate on clips, complete challenges, and earn rewards.
How do I join a Factory?
You can join a Factory after receiving an invitation or by being added by a Factory administrator.
How do I earn money?
You earn money by completing clips and challenges within a Factory. Rewards depend on the Factory's rules and campaign performance.
How can I withdraw my earnings?
Go to the Payments section and submit a withdrawal request using one of the available payment methods.
Where can I track my payments?
You can view your balance, transaction history, and withdrawal requests in the Payments section.
How do Challenges work?
Challenges are linked to specific clips within a Factory. Complete the challenge requirements for a clip to earn the associated reward.
What are Clips?
Clips are content tasks assigned within a Factory. Complete and submit them to participate in campaigns and earn rewards.
Why was my submission rejected?
Your submission may be rejected if it doesn't meet the campaign requirements or violates the Factory guidelines. Review the feedback, make the necessary changes, and submit it again if allowed.
How do I contact support?
There is no separate support team. If you need help or have any questions, simply contact your platform administrator directly.
What happens if I leave a Factory?
Leaving a Factory removes your access to its clips, challenges, and future tasks. Your completed work and payment history will remain available in your account.

Same screen, same components and copy. Only the colour variables and the font family now point at v2 tokens.
